facts.fact: The Ministry of Health's plan states that the Births and Deaths Registry, within the Ministry of Local Government and Rural Development, develops and manages the births and deaths registration system under Act 1027 of 2020; no date is given, so the plan's publication date is used.

systems.owner: Births and Deaths Registry, Ministry of Local Government and Rural Development
systems.tiers: district offices of the Registry are named

systems.system: Health-facility sharing of birth data and medical certificates of cause of death with the Births and Deaths Registry
systems.owner: Ministry of Health / Ghana Health Service health facilities
systems.tiers: health facilities in the districts, to the district offices of the Registry

systems.country_label: software of other data generators (e.g. BDR)

note: The plan does not say whether the Registry's offices record digitally: it says facility births are shared with the Registry's district offices, that a doctor's cause-of-death certificate is presented to the Registry for death registration, and lists the Registry's software only as an opportunity; the 2019 WHO SCORE assessment it cites found limited capacity for counting births and deaths.
